bio: I am a first-year student at Philippine Normal University (PNU), pursuing my passion for education and personal development. This portfolio serves as a comprehensive documentation of my learning journey, growth milestones, and professional development throughout my first year.

Through this portfolio, I aim to present not just what I have learned, but how I have grown as an individual and as an aspiring professional. Each piece of evidence reflects my commitment to excellence and my dedication to continuous improvement.

This collection represents my authentic self — the challenges I have faced, the lessons I have learned, and the progress I have made. It is a testament to the transformative power of education and the importance of self-reflection in the learning process.
introduction.purpose: This portfolio is designed to document and showcase my personal growth journey during Year 1 at PNU. It serves as a living record of my achievements, reflections, and development across the institution's five core outcomes.
guidingPrinciples: Excellence in Everything: I strive to give my best effort in all academic and personal endeavors, continuously raising the bar for myself.
Lifelong Learning: I embrace learning as a continuous process that extends beyond the classroom, seeking knowledge and skills that will serve me throughout my life.
Integrity and Authenticity: I value honesty and transparency in all my work, presenting my genuine experiences, growth, and areas for improvement.
Collaboration and Community: I recognize the importance of working with others and contributing positively to the communities I belong to.
Reflective Practice: I commit to regularly examining my experiences, learning from my mistakes, and using insights to guide my future actions.
